verses.1: Pavlos and Timotheus, servants of Christ Jesus, to all the saints in Christ Jesus, those who are in Philippi, along with the priests and ministers.
verses.2: May grace and peace be with you from our Father God, and from Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.3: I thank my God for all of your memories.
verses.4: At all times, in every request I make for you all, I will fulfill your requests with joy.
verses.5: In your community, from the first day until now, in connection with the gospel.
verses.6: You must believe that the one who began this good work among you will also complete it until the day of Christ Jesus.
verses.7: Since it is right for me to act in this way for all of you, because I have you in my heart. In my bonds and in my prayers, I seek to ensure that all those who belong to the community of the gospel are truly blessed.
verses.8: For my witness, God says that He will bring all of you under the power of Christ Jesus.
verses.9: And I pray that your love will become even greater and more intense in every sense of perception and feeling.
verses.10: To test you in distinguishing between the differences between them, so that you may be sincere and undeceived on the day of Christ.
verses.11: They have received the fruits of justice through Jesus Christ, for the glory and praise of God.
verses.12: I want to remind you, brothers, that what has been entrusted to me is more important than the spread of the gospel.
verses.13: So that my bonds become visible in Christ throughout the entire kingdom, and for all others as well.
verses.14: And those who were more powerful among their brothers, believing in my bonds, dared to speak against me more boldly.
verses.15: Some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, while others preach Him out of kindness.
verses.16: Those who do this out of love, knowing that they are being sent to be judged for the Gospel.
verses.17: But those who reject Christ in their hearts do so not out of sincerity, believing that they are thereby relieving my bonds.
verses.18: Why then? For in every way, whether through prophecy or truth, Christ is revealed. And in this, I rejoice. But I also shall be joyful.
verses.19: For I know that this will be a blessing for me, through your requests and the offering of the Spirit of Jesus Christ.
verses.20: In my despair and hope that I won’t be accused of anything, I believe that Christ will triumph over all obstacles, just as he always has done. Whether through life or death.
verses.21: For to me, living is Christ, and dying is gain.
verses.22: But if life lies in the flesh, then this is a burden of my work. I don’t know what else to choose.
verses.23: I continue with the second point: the desire to be united with Christ. After all, it’s much more important to do this.
verses.24: But it’s more necessary for you to apply this to your flesh.
verses.25: And knowing this, I know that I will continue to share with you all the joy and happiness that comes from your faith.
verses.26: So that your glory may increase in Christ Jesus, through my presence before you once more.
verses.27: Only by following the teachings of Christ can you truly be united with Him. Whether I come to see you or listen to what is said about you, I know that you stand together in one spirit, suffering together for the faith in the gospel.
verses.28: And they shall not be harmed by any of those authorities. This is an indication of their loss, while it is a sign of your salvation. And this comes from God.
verses.29: Because it brings joy to you, that is, for Christ’s sake. Not only because you believe in Him, but also because you suffer for Him.
verses.30: They also participated in that same battle. You know this, just as you hear about it from me now.
